sentences.text: Registry is requested to reflect the name of learned counsel Mr. D.K. Panda appearing for the informant in the cause list.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the informant and learned counsel for the State.
3.

The petitioner is an accused in connection with G.R. (Special) Case No.14 of 2023, pending in the file of learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge, Malkangiri, arising out of Malkangiri P.S. Case No.98 of 2023 for alleged commission of offences under Sections 376(3)/376(2)(n)/506 of IPC read with Section 6/15 of POCSO Act and Section 67(A)/67(B) of the I.T. Act.
4.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum- Special Judge, Malkangiri by order dated 21.06.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-cum- Special Judge, Malkangiri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. It is submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 28.02.2023 and as charge sheet has been filed on 22.04.2023, further continuance of the petitioner in custody is not warranted.
6. Learned counsel for the State as well as informant opposes the prayer for bail.
